what: Positional harness cases and outside-ROOT fallback contradict scan_file path contract
scenario_or_breakage: Planned tests call bash "$LINT" "$TMPROOT/scripts/good.sh" with default ROOT=$REPO_ROOT while scan_file always reads $ROOT/$rel; TMPROOT fixtures live outside the repo so scans miss fixtures or target wrong paths; the documented absolute-path fallback cannot work without changing scan_file
suggested_fix: In harness, pass --root "$TMPROOT" and repo-relative paths (e.g. scripts/good.sh) from TMPROOT cwd, or extend scan_file to read absolute paths when rel is absolute; drop the keep-contract wording unless scan_file is updated
